highlight: Spring grilling season kicks off, house offer on the line, and a pizza party with friends
family_message: This week is about patience and presence. The house offer may come through or it may not — either way, the family is together, the weather is gorgeous, and the grill is ready. Lean into the warmth of spring, the joy of cooking together, and the certainty that home is wherever you three are.
school_note: Normal school week for Elsie — no days off or early releases.

days.name: Sun 04/12
days.dinner_description: Kenji gold-standard chicken parm: buttermilk-marinated cutlets with shatteringly crisp breadcrumb crust, quick San Marzano sauce, and bubbly mozzarella.
days.album_description: Italy's king of soul and blues. Senza una donna is iconic, but the whole album grooves with Mediterranean passion.
days.album_sonic_description: Italian blues-soul, raspy vocals, electric guitar, organ, Mediterranean rhythms, raw emotional delivery
days.album_pairing_rationale: Italian soul for Italian comfort food — Zucchero's passionate vocals are the musical equivalent of Chicken Parm.
days.weather_detail: Sunny — 94% sunshine, 1% precip, 13 mph wind (gusts to 29 mph)

days.album: Earth, Wind & Fire – That's the Way of the World
